court_name: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
petitioner: Giri Textiles, through Proprietor Chandrayya R. Pasnuri
respondent: Anthony Nadar and Jainam Silk Mills
government_department_involved: Labour Court, Thane; Industrial Court, Thane; Labour Office

directives.text: Register the High Court's order dismissing the writ petition.
Forward the High Court's order to the Labour Court, Thane for further proceedings in Application (BIR) No. 1 of 2014.

Ensure the Labour Court, Thane proceeds with Application (BIR) No. 1 of 2014 on merits, uninfluenced by previous observations, except for the concluded issue on non-compliance with Section 42(4) of the Maharashtra Industrial Relations Act, 1946.
Ensure the Labour Court, Thane disposes of Application (BIR) No. 1 of 2014 within six months from the date of receipt of the High Court's order.
directives.deadline_text: Within six months from receipt of order

directives.text: File a compliance report with the High Court regarding the disposal of Application (BIR) No. 1 of 2014 within the stipulated period.

raw_summary: The High Court dismissed the writ petition, upholding the orders of the Labour Court and Industrial Court. The petitioner's objection regarding non-maintainability of the application due to non-compliance with Section 42(4) of the Maharashtra Industrial Relations Act, 1946 was rejected. The Labour Court was directed to proceed with the application and decide it on its merits, preferably within six months.
